_notes.context7: Upstash, verified on npm (v4.1.1). API key is optional and only raises rate limits.
_notes.playwright: Microsoft, verified on npm (v0.0.82). Used by test-engineer for React E2E.
_notes.github: GitHub's official remote MCP endpoint. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the environment; the server is simply unavailable until that is set.
_notes.semgrep: DELIBERATELY NOT WIRED YET. The npm package 'mcp-server-semgrep' exists (v1.0.1) but is community-published, and routing a security control through an unvetted dependency is not a safe default. Phase 4 decides between Semgrep's own PyPI server (semgrep-mcp) and the Docker CLI (docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" semgrep/semgrep semgrep scan --config p/owasp-top-ten), which is the more auditable option and works on Windows where the native CLI does not.
